figs.name: earth-fault-loop-impedance-path-diagram
figs.alt: earth fault loop impedance path through transformer, line, fault, CPC and PEN conductor
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the fault current loop in a TN C S supply with Ze 0.35 ohm and R1 plus R2 0.52 ohm, giving Zs 0.87 ohm and about 251 A.
figs.after_h2: What Is Earth Fault Loop Impedance?
figs.svg:

figs.name: earth-fault-loop-impedance-5-checks-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart of 5 checks for Zs testing with the 80 percent rule
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the five checks: measure Ze and R1 plus R2, work out Zs, compare with BS 7671 tables and apply the 80 percent rule.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 590" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Five check flowchart to confirm a breaker disconnects an earth fault in time</title>
<rect width="800" height="590" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#3730a3" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5 Checks for Safe Disconnection</text>
<rect x="60" y="55" width="340" height="60" rx="10" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230.0" y="79.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1. Measure Ze</text>
<text x="230.0" y="103.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">at origin: 0.35 Ω</text>
<line x1="230" y1="115" x2="230" y2="133" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="60" y="135" width="340" height="60" rx="10" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230.0" y="159.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2. Measure R1 + R2</text>
<text x="230.0" y="183.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">continuity: 0.52 Ω</text>
<line x1="230" y1="195" x2="230" y2="213" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="60" y="215" width="340" height="60" rx="10" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230.0" y="239.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3. Zs = Ze + R1 + R2</text>
<text x="230.0" y="263.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0.35 + 0.52 = 0.87 Ω</text>
<line x1="230" y1="275" x2="230" y2="293" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="60" y="295" width="340" height="60" rx="10" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230.0" y="319.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4. Compare with table</text>
<text x="230.0" y="343.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Type B 32 A: 1.37 Ω</text>
<line x1="230" y1="355" x2="230" y2="383" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="230,385.0 390.0,440 230,495.0 70.0,440" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230" y="435.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5. Zs under 80%</text>
<text x="230" y="457.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">of table (1.10 Ω)?</text>
<line x1="230" y1="495" x2="230" y2="518" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="244" y="512" font-size="17" fill="#3730a3" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Yes</text>
<rect x="70" y="520" width="320" height="60" rx="10" fill="#4f46e5" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230.0" y="544.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PASS: 0.87 Ω ≤ 1.10 Ω</text>
<text x="230.0" y="568.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">record on test schedule</text>
<line x1="390" y1="440" x2="468" y2="440" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="428" y="430" font-size="17" fill="#3730a3" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="470" y="395" width="310" height="90" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="625.0" y="422.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Lower the loop</text>
<text x="625.0" y="446.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">larger CPC, shorter route</text>
<text x="625.0" y="470.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Type B curve or add RCD</text>
<polyline points="625,395 625,265 402,265" fill="none" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)" stroke-dasharray="7 5"/>
<text x="637" y="335" font-size="18" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">retest</text>
<rect x="470" y="55" width="310" height="185" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="486" y="89" font-size="20" fill="#3730a3" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Why 80 percent?</text>
<text x="486" y="123" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Conductors heat up in</text>
<text x="486" y="153" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">a fault, so resistance rises.</text>
<text x="486" y="183" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Cold 1.37 Ω would fail;</text>
<text x="486" y="213" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">1.10 Ω or less passes.</text>
</svg>
